comments.text: The sheer vertical drama of the Dolomites is almost surreal to look at! The way those limestone peaks slice right through the mist shows how rugged alpine Italy truly is. Nature really sculpted an entirely different world in these northern regions.

comments.text: I love how this video looks past the postcard images of Italy to show the wild, rugged side. The scene of the Alpine Ibex and the Abruzzo wolves was breathtaking.
